analysis:
Both units are base-side excerpts of CHANGELOG.md (base lines 458-656 and 657-850). No patch hunks or head text were supplied, so the actual PR delta cannot be identified, which is a coverage limit. The file is documentation only: it is not executable, and nothing in these excerpts changes authorization, attestation, encryption, billing or availability behavior.

The excerpted entries describe security-relevant behavior already shipped in earlier releases. They match the existing threat model and are not new regressions:
- v0.9.11: App Attest serves protocol 3 only, and attestation challenges fail closed (TB-011, T-052..T-058).
- v0.9.11: unauthenticated earnings lookup removed (T-031).
- v0.9.11/v0.9.12: SSD prefix-cache TTL raised from 15 to 30 minutes, recorded as the SEC-035 re-acceptance (T-041). The T-041 definition reflects the 30-minute TTL.
- v0.9.12: cache-routing persistence stores no prompts, raw chain hashes or memory-tier holders.
- v0.9.10 to v0.9.14: SSD prefix-cache defaults extended to additional models (Qwen3.5-9B, MiMo, Bonsai), with the global kill switch retained.

The integration pass should check whether the real diff is code or workflow files and whether any changelog claim there is unsupported. In particular, check any new default-on cache coverage against the T-041 per-donation gating and account-scope isolation.
